title: juncus glaucus subsp. diffusus
intro: Juncus glaucus subsp. diffusus, commonly known as Diffuse Soft Rush, is a subspecies of the Juncus glaucus plant, a type of rush that belongs to the family Juncaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Juncus glaucus subsp. diffusus include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its ability to soothe and protect the mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
